content:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT CLOSED] Pager #4218 — inference-router-us-west-2. Duration: 00:14:12. Root cause suspected: routing cache evictions during KV-cache churn. Mitigation: rolled back routing policy and restarted router. Evidence archived: s3://redwood-incidents/4218/

sara: Taking RCA ownership. I'll draft timeline and mitigation notes. Requesting logs + metrics.

mike: On it. I'll pull router + control-plane logs and upload snippets to the evidence folder.

mike: ```bash
kubectl logs -n inference router-abc123 --since=30m > /tmp/router-4218.log
aws s3 cp /tmp/router-4218.log s3://redwood-incidents/4218/
```

josh: Adding runtime observations — replica A saw kv-cache churn spike to ~3200 ops/s at 09:12:05. Will include metric graphs in doc.

emma: Need concise customer impact summary for support/comm. Which orgs saw >500ms? @sara can you pull the list?

sara: I'll extract from telemetry and post list. Tentative: 14 orgs with intermittent errors, 1 enterprise with SLA degradation.

ana: Legal — please loop me on customer notice draft before sending. We'll need a short factual statement.

tlewis: I'll review kernel/compile notes and check if any config changes triggered a different kernel path.

mike: Uploaded logs + a couple of grep snippets to s3 and added links in tracker. Action added: create alert for kv-cache-churn >2k ops/s (OPS-490).

josh: Action: instrument per-model kv eviction counters and expose in Prometheus (ENG-881). PR planned tomorrow.

emma: Action for comms: draft notification for affected customers and internal blurb (COMMS-332). Waiting on exact list from @sara.

sara: Plan: share initial RCA draft in Google Doc tomorrow 10:00 PT. Reviewers: josh, mike, tlewis. Reviewer deadline: 48h. Sign-off: eng lead + product. @ana to confirm legal sign-off requirement.

ana: Legal will review the draft. Please add me as comment-only reviewer.

mike: Estimate 3-4h to draft timeline w/ log timestamps. Will attach grep output and salient errors.

sara: Meeting to walk through RCA draft: 2024-06-15 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent). If you can't make, leave comments in doc. Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/FAKE-ID (RCA-4218) :memo:

josh: Quick snippet for repo refs: runtime PRs that touched kv cache logic in last 2 days: runtime/main@a1b2c3 ; runtime/cache@d4e5f6.

sara: I'll update tracker with action items and owners: PM-721 (RCA write), ENG-881 (kv metrics, owner=josh), OPS-490 (alert, owner=mike), COMMS-332 (customer notice, owner=emma). Changing statuses as we make progress.

mike: :white_check_mark: Added evidence links + timeline draft in doc comments.

tlewis: :eyes: Will do sign-off on platform aspects after review.

sara: Thanks everyone — please tag me with any blockers. Goal: peer-review sign-offs within 72h and public customer notice (if needed) after legal review.
